# Anthony Smith

> Senior Software Engineer with 15+ years building production systems, specializing in application and API security. Open to full-time roles and contract or freelance work. Based in Grand Rapids, Michigan, US.

Knows about application security, API security, the OWASP API Security Top 10, React Native, TypeScript, Supabase, and AI and LLM integrations.

## About

## Products
- [CastLog](https://castlogapp.com/): Voice-first fishing journal. Say the catch and it logs the lake, weather, and moon phase, including offline. iOS is on the App Store, and an Android test is open.
- [Nutrilogix](https://nutrilogix-ai.com/): AI nutrition tracking. Snap a plate or say what you ate to log calories and macros, and sync workouts from Apple Health. The iOS beta is open.
- [VoiceLift](https://voicelift.app/): Voice-first workout logging. Say a set and it is logged, including gym slang, supersets, and partials. A waitlist is open.
- [CallCatch](https://anthonys1760.github.io/callcatch-landing/): Answers from a business's own website, does not invent a price, and turns unanswered questions into leads. A Rogue River Labs product for HVAC, plumbing, and electrical companies.
- [Rogue River Labs](https://rogueriverlabs.dev/): Builds mobile apps and the APIs behind them, and finds where access checks break. Founded by Anthony Smith.
- [Portfolio](https://anthonysdigital.net/portfolio.html): Selected work, including CastLog, Nutrilogix, VoiceLift, CallCatch, and Rogue River Labs.
